findings.message: negative frame (anlamına gelmez / demek değildir): 3 times in the document, 1 of 24 paragraphs end with it. One use is fine. Keep the instances that add a distinct condition; say the rest directly or merge them.

limitations: Counts wording, not meaning: a conclusion restated in new words is found only through --claims or reading.
Candidates, not errors. A family below its threshold is not reported; a reported one may be justified.
Reads the same scope as editorial-check: frontmatter, JSX props and alt text are not covered. Use rendered-check.mjs on the built page.
Rhythm figures describe the text; they are not a target, a quota or an authorship score.
Advisory lexical/structural candidates, not authorship detection or clinical approval.
Semantic repetition and medication-section equivalence still need whole-text editorial reading.
Frontmatter summaries/FAQs and JSX props/expressions require separate visible-text inspection.
Block quotations are excluded from editorial suggestions; punctuation and passive voice are not banned.
